arabic text: AY SHAAM KE LOGON MEIN BINTE ALI HOON
english translation text: OH PEOPLE OF SHAAM, I'M THE DAUGHTER OF ALI (AS)
I'M THE INHERITOR OF PURITY, I'M\nTHE HONOUR OF THE PROPHET (PBUH)

arabic text: BAZAAR SE DARBAAR MEIN LEY AAEY HO MUJHKO\nCHAHOON TO JALA SAKTI HOON KHUTBON SE MEIN TUMKO\nSABIR KI BAHEN HOON JO MEIN KHAMOSH KHARI HOON
english translation text: I'M THE INHERITOR OF PURITY, I'M THE HONOUR OF THE PROPHET (PBUH), YOU'VE BROUGHT\nME FROM THE BAZAR TO THE COURT, IF I WISH, I COULD BURN YOU\nWITH MY SERMONS, I'M THE SISTER OF THE PATIENT ONE HENCE STANDING IN SILENCE,

arabic text: AFSOS KANEEZI MEIN USAY MAANG RAHAY HO\nTUM JISKAY GHULAMON KI GHULAMI MEIN RAHAY HO\nYEH ZULM NA HOGA KABHI MEIN ZINDA ABHI HOON
english translation text: IT IS A SHAME THAT YOU'RE ASKING TO TAKE HER AS A SLAVE,\nYOU OUGHT TO BE THE SERVANT OF HER SERVANTS,\nTHIS OPPRESSION WILL NEVER TAKE PLACE WHILE I AM STILL ALIVE

arabic text: TUM APNE PAYAMBAR KO AGAR DEKHNA CHAHO\nNAIZAY PE JO YEH SAR HAI ISAY GHOR SE DEKHO\nHAM SHAKL-E-PAYAMABAR HAI YEH MEIN ISKI PHUPI HOON
english translation text: IF YOU WISH TO SEE YOUR PROPHET (PBUH),\nLOOK CAREFULLY AT THIS HEAD ON THE SPEAR,\nHE IS THE IMAGE OF THE PROPHET AND I AM HIS AUNT

arabic text: AUR ISS SE KATHAN WAQT KYA HOGA MEYRAI MABOOD\nFIZZA KE TARAFDAAR HAIN DARBAAR MEIN MOJOOD\nMEIN PUSHT PE FIZZA KE KHARI DEKH RAHI HOON
english translation text: OH LORD! WHAT CAN BE MORE DIFFICULT TIME THAN THIS,\nEVEN THE SUPPORTERS OF FIZZA ARE PRESENT IN THE COURT,\nI AM STANDING BEHIND FIZZA WATCHING EVERYTHING

arabic text: ZEHRA KO BHI DARBAAR MEIN TUM NE THA BULAYA\nDARBAAR MEIN MEIN BHI HOON MAGAR FARQ HAI ITNA\nPARDAY MEIN THI VOH AUR MEIN BEY PARDA KHARI HOON
english translation text: YOU HAD ALSO CALLED BIBI ZAHRA (S.A) TO THE COURT,\nI TOO AM IN THE COURT BUT THE DIFFERENCE IS THIS,\nSHE WAS HER VEIL ON, AND I'M NOT

arabic text: HONAY LAGI DARBAAR MEIN MUSHTAR KA AZAANEIN\nREHAN IDHAR NAAM-E-NABI GOONJA FIZA MEIN\nBIBI NE KAHA FAKHR SE MEIN JEET GAEE HOON
english translation text: IN THE COURT THE ADHAN IS BEING RECITED,\nWHEN THE NAME OF THE PROPHET ECHOED IN THE COURT,\nBIBI ZAINAB (A.) SAID WITH PRIDE THAT I HAVE WON
